description: Test whether ClinVar pathogenic PLPBP missense variants are buried in the protein core or clustered at the PLP site
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# ---------- ClinVar (re-fetch; namespace not persistent) ----------
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils"
r=requests.get(f"{E}/esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":'PLPBP[gene] AND "missense variant"[molecular consequence]',"retmax":"500","retmode":"json"},timeout=90)
ids=r.json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    rr=requests.get(f"{E}/esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"},timeout=120).json()["result"]
    for k in rr.get("uids",[]):
        v=rr[k]; recs.append((v.get("title",""), v.get("germline_classification",{}).get("description","")))
    time.sleep(0.4)
three={'Ala':'A','Arg':'R','Asn':'N','Asp':'D','Cys':'C','Gln':'Q','Glu':'E','Gly':'G','His':'H','Ile':'I',
       'Leu':'L','Lys':'K','Met':'M','Phe':'F','Pro':'P','Ser':'S','Thr':'T','Trp':'W','Tyr':'Y','Val':'V'}
rows=[]
for t,c in recs:
    m=re.search(r"\(p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Z][a-z]{2})\)",t)
    if m and m.group(3)!="Ter":
        rows.append((three.get(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2)),three.get(m.group(3)),c))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["wt","pos","mt","clin"]).drop_duplicates(subset=["wt","pos","mt"])
df=df[(df.pos>=1)&(df.pos<=275)]
def grp(c):
    c=(c or "").lower()
    if "pathogenic" in c and "conflict" not in c: return "pathogenic"
    if "benign" in c and "conflict" not in c: return "benign"
    if "uncertain" in c: return "VUS"
    return "other"
df["grp"]=df.clin.apply(grp)

# ---------- structure ----------
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/O94903",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=90).text
atoms=[]
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        atoms.append((l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms,columns=["name","res","num","x","y","z"])
cb=A[(A.name=="CB")|((A.name=="CA")&(A.res=="GLY"))].set_index("num")[["x","y","z"]]
coords=cb.values; idx=list(cb.index)
D=np.linalg.norm(coords[:,None,:]-coords[None,:,:],axis=-1)
ncount=pd.Series((D<10).sum(1)-1, index=idx)           # burial proxy
nz=A[(A.num==47)&(A.name=="NZ")][["x","y","z"]].values[0]
dist47=pd.Series(np.linalg.norm(coords-nz,axis=1), index=idx)

df["burial"]=df.pos.map(ncount); df["d47"]=df.pos.map(dist47)
sub=df[df.grp.isin(["pathogenic","benign","VUS"])]
print(sub.groupby("grp")[["burial","d47"]].agg(["median","count"]).round(1).to_string())
print("\nPathogenic variants:")
print(df[df.grp=="pathogenic"][["wt","pos","mt","burial","d47"]].sort_values("pos").round(1).to_string(index=False))
print("\nBenign variants:")
print(df[df.grp=="benign"][["wt","pos","mt","burial","d47"]].sort_values("pos").round(1).to_string(index=False))

p_=sub[sub.grp=="pathogenic"]; b_=sub[sub.grp=="benign"]; v_=sub[sub.grp=="VUS"]
u1,pv1=stats.mannwhitneyu(p_.burial, pd.concat([b_,v_]).burial, alternative="greater")
u2,pv2=stats.mannwhitneyu(p_.d47,    pd.concat([b_,v_]).d47,    alternative="less")
print("\nBurial (neighbour count within 10 A of CB): pathogenic median {:.0f} vs benign+VUS median {:.0f}".format(
    p_.burial.median(), pd.concat([b_,v_]).burial.median()))
print("  Mann-Whitney U = {:.0f}, one-sided p = {:.4f}".format(u1,pv1))
print("Distance to K47 NZ: pathogenic median {:.1f} A vs benign+VUS median {:.1f} A".format(
    p_.d47.median(), pd.concat([b_,v_]).d47.median()))
print("  Mann-Whitney U = {:.0f}, one-sided p = {:.4f}".format(u2,pv2))
print("\nNOTE: only {} pathogenic and {} benign missense variants are classified; power is limited.".format(len(p_),len(b_)))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.2))
order=["benign","VUS","pathogenic"]; cols={"benign":"#54A24B","VUS":"#BAB0AC","pathogenic":"#D62728"}
for ax,col,lab in zip(axes,["burial","d47"],
        ["Burial: CB neighbours within 10 A","Distance to K47 NZ (angstrom)"]):
    for i,g in enumerate(order):
        v=sub[sub.grp==g][col].values
        ax.scatter(np.random.normal(i,0.08,len(v)),v,color=cols[g],s=38,alpha=0.85,edgecolor="none")
        ax.hlines(np.median(v),i-0.25,i+0.25,color="black",lw=2)
    ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels(["benign\n(n={})".format(len(b_)),"VUS\n(n={})".format(len(v_)),"pathogenic\n(n={})".format(len(p_))])
    ax.set_ylabel(lab)
axes[0].set_title("Pathogenic PLPBP missense variants hit the buried core\nMann-Whitney p = {:.3f}".format(pv1))
axes[1].set_title("Proximity to the PLP site is not what separates them\nMann-Whitney p = {:.3f}".format(pv2))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
